references.text: The Mosaic law commands that everything that breathes shall be devoted to destruction in the cities that the Lord gives Israel as an inheritance, which is directly fulfilled in Joshua 11:11
The command to devote to destruction and show no mercy to the peoples of the promised land
Jericho was also devoted to destruction in the same way, where all living things were killed with the sword
Jericho was also burned with fire, just as Hazor was burned in this verse
Ai was also burned and made into a ruin heap, corresponding to the treatment of Hazor
Makkedah was treated in the same way - all souls were devoted to destruction without anyone surviving
Debir and the whole land were devoted to destruction; not one who breathed was spared
Hazor is mentioned as an important kingdom in the time of the judges, showing the city's continued significance
Solomon rebuilt Hazor, confirming that the city was destroyed as stated in Joshua
